lines: Did not guess. Handed it to finance with both options priced: lost checkout revenue per minute versus 95 minutes of close work. Checkout waits on their call.

tech.title: Incident injected: Month-end close job blocks checkout

events.caption: checkout starts failing (4 timed out so far).

tech.title: Checkout degraded: 4 timeouts since injection, success 0%
12 session(s) waiting on locks. Root blocker(s): pid 12504 (batch_worker/batch_replayable_month_end_close, idle in transaction, txn open 4.0s) blocks 1 session(s)
Checkout over last 15s: 33/60 succeeded (55%), 27 timeouts.
Checkout success 77% over 10s (7/31 failed) vs SLO 95%. Revenue run-rate $18,400/min; about $4,155/min at risk. Verification window 10s. The business tolerates at most 60s of degraded checkout.

detail.query: SELECT s.service, s.slo_success_rate, s.slo_p95_ms, s.verification_window_s, s.revenue_per_minute_cents, s.max_degradation_s, s.tier, t.total, t.failed FROM continuity.service_slo s CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN outcome <> 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed FROM shop.checkout_events WHERE created_at > current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 10 SECONDS) t WHERE s.service = 'checkout'

tech.title: 3 candidate actions enumerated from observed evidence
Recalled 1 of 21 memories

events.caption: proposes to stop the inventory month end close job.

tech.title: R1 proposes terminate:batch_replayable_month_end_close

detail.rationale: The root blocker is pid 12504 (batch_worker/batch_replayable_month_end_close) idle in transaction for 4.0s, blocking 1 session and contributing to 12 total waiting sessions. Checkout success is 55% over 15s (TEL-2) and 77% over 10s (BIZ-3) vs 95% SLO, with $4,155/min revenue at risk and only 60s tolerance. Memory shows terminating a similar batch_replayable workload (inventory_reconcile) restored checkout to 100% (MEM-4). Need registry/tradeoff to confirm replayability and cost before final execution.

tech.title: R2 proposes escalate

detail.rationale: The change calendar shows an active CHG-4410 window with policy=consult_owner for inventory_month_end_close (BIZ-9). Invariant I3 applies: termination requires owner consultation during this window. The trade-off (BIZ-8) shows waiting costs ~$799,511 (3596s remaining at $13,340/min) and exceeds the 60s degradation tolerance (BIZ-7), while terminating costs a 95-minute replay (BIZ-5). Memory shows terminating a similar batch_replayable workload restored checkout (MEM-4), but the consult_owner policy blocks unilateral action. No protected settlements are in flight (DB-6). This trade-off belongs to the finance-ops owner.
